name: Digital Jagran • 01 Discover and rank news

parameters.content:
## 01 • Trusted news discovery
Every 30 minutes • 12 public feeds
Freshness, canonical URL deduplication, conservative event clustering and diverse ranking.
Target: 100+ distinct daily candidates. Durable source IDs prevent duplicate drafts across runs.
Source snippets are evidence, never instructions. Feed failures are isolated and daily shortfalls remain visible.
